test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Brihat Samhita, what do you call the process of making scents, mouth perfumes and bath powders?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhayukli.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An** encyclopaedia **written in Sanskrit and published in the** sixth century in Ujjain** was called **Brhat-Samhita.**
 
• In addition to divination, the book covers a wide range of topics, such as** astronomy, planetary motion, eclipses, rainfall, architecture, crop development, perfume production, matrimony, household relationships, gems, and ceremonies.**
 
• **Varahmihir’s Brihat Samhita **gives references to perfumes and cosmetics.
 
• Recipes for hair dying were made from plants, like indigo and minerals like iron power, black iron or steel and acidic extracts of sour rice gruel.
 
• **Gandhayukli describes recipes for making scents, mouth perfumes, bath powders, incense and talcum powder.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamplcica, Pattanga and Jatuka:**

 
 
• **A number of classical texts, like Atharvaveda (1000 BCE) **mention some **dye stuff, the material used were turmeric, madder, sunflower, orpiment, cochineal and lac.**
 
• Some other substances having tinting properties were **Kamplcica, Pattaya and Jatuka.**
